description: This PHP source file defines the Address controller class within the Opencart admin customer namespace. It handles various customer address operations such as listing addresses, displaying address forms, and saving address data, including validation and interaction with the customer model.

classes.name: Address
classes.description: The Address controller class manages customer address-related functionalities in the OpenCart admin panel, such as listing, editing, and adding addresses.

classes.description: The Address controller class manages customer address-related functionalities in the OpenCart admin panel, such as listing, editing, adding, and deleting addresses.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the address data for a given customer ID.
